name: Joseph M. Barbuto
occupation: Sweetwater County treasurer at the time of the 2022 general election (Rocket Miner, Nov. 9, 2022)
prior_offices: Sweetwater County treasurer (incumbent defeated in the November 2022 general election)
background: Joseph M. Barbuto, a Democrat, was the incumbent Sweetwater County treasurer in 2022 and lost the November 8 general election to Republican Mark Cowan. The Rocket Miner reported the unofficial totals as 8,069 votes for Cowan and 3,659 for Barbuto.
